name: Navior's species
description: A species with large wide eyes existed in the galaxy. They were covered in brown fur, and possessed short beaks, a single antennae, and a tail. They had short legs with two toes on each foot. The Podracer pilot "Bullseye" Navior was a member of this species, and his nickname of "Bullseye" was actually derived from his large, gaping eyes.
